findings.text: When the captured `stack` has fewer than 3 lines, `stackWithoutTwoTopLines` becomes '' and `String(err.stack).endsWith('')` is always true, so the dedupe check wrongly succeeds and the async stack is never appended. The original regex left a short stack unchanged, so it was still compared and appended. Example: with `Error.stackTraceLimit = 1` or 2, a rejected request whose `err.stack` already exists loses the call-site frames.
